model_type: CatBoost approximation of an evidence-calibrated proxy; not trained on observed admissions

target.name: hospital_surge_pct
target.source_assumption: Project metadata's externally sourced, non-Pune-specific all-cause hospitalization association; applying a daily-mean coefficient to the prototype's 10:00-16:00 temperature is an unvalidated proxy assumption.

excluded_features_and_reasons.ward_id: No observed ward-specific outcome labels to estimate ward effects.
excluded_features_and_reasons.population: A percentage uplift does not scale with population; use population only for absolute baseline demand calculations.
excluded_features_and_reasons.heatwave_duration_and_severity: Prototype source has daytime mean temperature, not validated daily maximum/observed outcomes; no evidence-supported independent heatwave effect is available.
excluded_features_and_reasons.elderly_pct: Not present in the supplied ward data.

validation.method: Chronological by full calendar year: train 2024, validation 2025, held-out proxy test 2026.
validation.metrics_interpretation: Measures approximation of the constructed proxy only; does not establish hospital-demand or clinical predictive accuracy.
